title: 2013 AMC 12B Problem 2
statement: Mr. Green measures his rectangular garden by walking two of the sides and finds that it is \(15\) steps by \(20\) steps. Each of Mr. Green’s steps is \(2\) feet long. Mr. Green expects a half a pound of potatoes per square foot from his garden. How many pounds of potatoes does Mr. Green expect from his garden?

solutions.text: The garden is \(2\cdot 15 = 30\) feet by \(2\cdot 20 = 40\) feet, an area of \(1200\) square feet. At half a pound per square foot, Mr. Green expects \(\tfrac12\cdot 1200 = 600\) pounds. Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Convert steps to feet first: each step is \(2\) feet
Multiply the area in square feet by \(\dfrac12\) pound per square foot
